A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. All 17 pages of each version, including equations, tables, figures, and appendices, are readable and support comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original multilingual probing, representation-alignment, false-premise prompting, and fine-tuning experiments, with additional results and ablations in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the prompting comparison in Table 2 and the fine-tuning and transferability results in the appendices.

M1.justification: Layer-wise probing, mean shifting, linear projection, and bilingual question-translation fine-tuning retain the same procedures. Moving existing fine-tuning details into Section 6 does not introduce a method change.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same language and task coverage: true/false-premise questions, entity-based answerability, and true/false statements across FRESHQAPARALLEL, SEAREFUSE, and TRUEFALSEMULTILANG.

E2.justification: The comparisons retain the same methods, including vanilla, mean-shifted, and linearly projected representations, in-distribution probes, and unhinted versus FP-Hinted generation.

E3.justification: Evaluated models, accuracy metrics, the stated 80/20 split for dimensionality analysis, and fine-tuning settings are unchanged. The settings inserted into Section 6 were already documented in v1 Appendix E.

E4.justification: Both retain the dimensionality and participation-ratio analysis, fine-tuning transfer analyses, non-parallel mean-shifting comparison, and pooling ablation. v1 Appendices J and K become v2 Appendices I and J without changing their analyses.

E5.justification: Language-averaged reporting remains unchanged. Neither version reports seed or repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 2–6 and Figures 2–14 retain the same results and findings. For example, Table 2 gives the same Vietnamese baseline and FP-Hinted scores of 19.73 and 44.22 for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.

T1.justification: The mean-shifting equations, least-squares projection and pseudoinverse derivation, effective-dimensionality definition, and participation-ratio formula are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: cross-lingual knowledge-boundary analysis, the multilingual evaluation suite, training-free alignment, and improvements from question-translation fine-tuning.

C2.justification: The denoising explanation for low-resource subspaces, hypothesized self-defense mechanism, and limitation concerning evolving representations during generation remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Existing implementation information moves from v1 Appendix E to v2 Section 6. LoRA rank 32 and alpha 64, learning rates, batch size 512, hardware, and DeepSpeed configuration remain the same, as do code and data access information.

R1.justification: The bibliography and substantive positioning relative to prior work are unchanged. Section 1 introduces an unresolved '?' citation marker, but it identifies no additional cited work.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited grammatical and terminology corrections, adds an author affiliation, and moves the fine-tuning implementation paragraph into Section 6, shifting subsequent appendix labels. It also introduces an unresolved citation marker in the introduction.

P2.justification: Table 3 moves from PDF page 6 to page 7 beside its analysis. Captions receive small wording edits and text reflows, while the plotted content and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Copyediting and placing existing fine-tuning settings in Section 6 offer small readability benefits, while the new unresolved citation in Section 1 introduces a presentation defect. The methods, empirical support, explanations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged. These limited editorial changes leave overall paper quality essentially the same.
